SELECT task_id AS "taskId", COUNT(*) AS "totalBatch", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 END) AS "completedBatch", COUNT(CASE WHEN error_stack IS NOT NULL AND error_stack <> '' THEN 1 END) AS "errorBatch", COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "waitingBatch", MIN(start_time) AS "startTime", MAX(end_time) AS "endTime" FROM bill.inmemory_task_batch
AND start_time >= #{startTime}::timestamp
AND start_time <= #{endTime}::timestamp
AND task_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{taskId}, '%')
GROUP BY task_id ORDER BY MIN(start_time) DESC
SELECT id, task_id, batch_id, start_time, end_time, status, error_stack, update_time, label, create_time FROM bill.inmemory_task_batch WHERE task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY start_time ASC
SELECT status AS "status", COUNT(*) AS "cnt" FROM bill.inmemory_task_batch WHERE task_id = #{taskId} GROUP BY status
